Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.label: UH-1B
Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.description:
A utility helicopter designed and manufactured by Bell Helicopter. Known officially as "Iroquois" and more commonly as "Huey," the UH-1 series formed the backbone of the US Army helicopter fleet for decades, and was widely exported internationally. The UH-1B was an upgraded version of the original production UH-1A aircraft with an improved engine and new rotorblades. It was used as both a transport/utility aircraft (a configuration known as "slick") and also as a gunship.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Pilot x2, Passenger x4
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
